name: Pancake, Middle & Jenny Lind Creeks

lines.name: Pancake Creek – Middle Creek
lines.limitSrc: two entrances: Pancake Creek entrance (km 0) → Middle Island divide (km ≈ 11.9) → Middle Creek mouth on Bustard Bay (km 21.8)

lines.name: Jenny Lind Creek
lines.limitSrc: own entrance under Bustard Head; modelled to the end of the perennial reach (QLD watercourse lines; DEM all < 4 m)

lines.name: Tanti Creek
lines.limitSrc: end of mapped waterway (QLD watercourse lines; DEM all < 4 m)

M.name: Entrance (≈ MSQ Pancake Creek)
M.src: MSQ 2025 Tidal Planes secondary place Pancake Creek: HW -35 min, LW -35 min on Gladstone (Auckland Point); ratio 0.75, cons +0.00; planes MHWS 3.01 MHWN 2.37 MLWN 1.22 MLWS 0.58, MSL 1.80 m LAT

M.name: Middle Island divide (est.)
M.src: Divide between the two entrances (Pancake and Middle creeks connect over it at high tide): generic lag growth 11.9 km from the Pancake Creek entrance (HW +2.0, LW +3.2 min/km); highs 0.15 m lower, lows 0.30 m higher (assumed)

M.name: Middle Creek mouth (≈ MSQ Seventeen Seventy)
M.src: MSQ 2025 Tidal Planes secondary place Seventeen Seventy: HW -35 min, LW -22 min on Gladstone (Auckland Point); ratio 0.70, cons +0.00; planes MHWS 2.81 MHWN 2.21 MLWN 1.14 MLWS 0.54, MSL 1.66 m LAT — nearest MSQ place on Bustard Bay, ≈ 8 km SE of this mouth

T1.name: Jenny Lind entrance (≈ MSQ Pancake Creek)
T1.src: MSQ 2025 Tidal Planes secondary place Pancake Creek: HW -35 min, LW -35 min on Gladstone (Auckland Point); ratio 0.75, cons +0.00; planes MHWS 3.01 MHWN 2.37 MLWN 1.22 MLWS 0.58, MSL 1.80 m LAT — Jenny Lind entrance is ≈ 3.9 km along the coast from the Pancake Creek place

T1.name: Tidal limit (est.)
T1.src: Generic extrapolation 6.8 km beyond the last calibration: median lag growth of calibrated QLD places/gauges in the Agnes Water region (HW +2.0, LW +3.2 min/km); at a natural tidal limit highs ≈ 0.15 m lower than downstream and lows drain out (pool level 0.15 m, assumed)

T2.name: Entrance (≈ MSQ Pancake Creek)
T2.src: MSQ 2025 Tidal Planes secondary place Pancake Creek: HW -35 min, LW -35 min on Gladstone (Auckland Point); ratio 0.75, cons +0.00; planes MHWS 3.01 MHWN 2.37 MLWN 1.22 MLWS 0.58, MSL 1.80 m LAT

T2.name: Tanti Creek junction
T2.src: Middle Creek side of the passage, 2.3 km inside its mouth (generic lag growth)

T2.name: Tidal limit (est.)
T2.src: Generic extrapolation 3.9 km beyond the last calibration: median lag growth of calibrated QLD places/gauges in the Agnes Water region (HW +2.0, LW +3.2 min/km); at a natural tidal limit highs ≈ 0.15 m lower than downstream and lows drain out (pool level 0.14 m, assumed)

landmarks.name: Mouth / entrance (Pancake Creek)
landmarks.note: between Clews Point and Pancake Point; popular yacht anchorage inside

landmarks.name: Middle Island divide (est.)
landmarks.note: narrow natural channel: Pancake and Middle creeks join over it at high tide; dries at low (assumed)

landmarks.name: Jenny Lind Creek entrance
landmarks.note: under Bustard Head (lighthouse on the headland); links to Pancake Creek over the flats on bigger spring tides

confidence.why: no gauge in the network: two-entrance estimate from MSQ secondary places (Pancake Creek, Seventeen Seventy) with generic lag growth and an assumed divide — benchmark me

sources: Geometry: Queensland Government watercourse lines (QSpatial, CC BY 4.0) + trace on Esri World Imagery (Pancake Creek basin, estuary mouths); OpenStreetMap checked (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL)

Tides: MSQ 2025 Tidal Planes secondary places Pancake Creek and Seventeen Seventy on Gladstone (Auckland Point); Gladstone harmonics fitted offline to MSQ 2026 predictions (data.qld.gov.au, CC-BY 4.0)
Connections: Australian Wetlands Directory QLD127 (Middle Island, Pancake & Middle creeks); Copernicus GLO-90 DEM (via Open-Meteo)

nnames: Middle Creek mouth (≈ MSQ Seventeen Seventy)
twoEnt.fit: Not fitted (no gauge): south wave = MSQ Pancake Creek, north wave = MSQ Seventeen Seventy, generic lag growth (HW +2.0, LW +3.2 min/km), blended by a logistic weight centred at the assumed divide (km 11.94, width 1.0 km). Benchmark me.
twoEnt.gNote: No gauges in this network: tides are estimates from MSQ secondary places.
